verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official CLI that covers the entire platform, a Python SDK, a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, and scoped API keys that the docs explicitly recommend for CI/CD and automation. Together these clearly support headless, scripted use, including end-to-end search, rent, connect, copy and clean-up flows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, such as a documented CI pipeline example or a community report.
